title: Complete host discovery and system-fact coverage
recommendation: Research only: native-first infraternal agent collector, in one-shot probe mode over SSH after a tiny OS/architecture/shell sniff. The owner decides defaults, OS support tiers and API integrations.
coverage_note: One cell per listed fact × OS family. Each cell references a recipe containing command, fallback, root requirement, cost, parallelism, privacy and parsing notes. Unsupported/API-only/unknown are explicit; failure is never treated as absence.

default_policy.note: Preserve D126 Machine tab defaults; all additional facts remain opt-in pending owner decision.

discovery_sources.yields: Peer names/IDs, overlay IP, OS/version and local connection/SSH hints.
discovery_sources.ssh_acceptance: ssh_enabled/server_ssh_allowed are hints, not proof of current-user auth; status opens no peer login.
discovery_sources.cost: low local daemon IPC; proposed 1 s cap, not measured.
discovery_sources.failure: daemon missing/stopped, stale view, schema drift, DNS/peer access.

discovery_sources.yields: Tailnet peers, names, addresses and state; JSON schema can change.

discovery_sources.privacy: very high; show aggregate presence by default.
discovery_sources.cost: low local daemon IPC; proposed 1 s cap, not measured.

discovery_sources.yields: Previously trusted host key for a known candidate; hashed names cannot be enumerated/reversed.
discovery_sources.ssh_acceptance: No; previous trust does not prove current reachability or acceptance.
discovery_sources.privacy: very high; never expose raw records/fingerprints by default.
discovery_sources.failure: unknown hashed name, key changed/revoked, aliases/multiple files.

discovery_sources.source: ~/.ssh/config and Include files; avoid blind ssh -G
discovery_sources.yields: Aliases, hostnames, ports, usernames, ProxyJump and key paths.
discovery_sources.ssh_acceptance: No; Match/Include are order-sensitive; Match exec can run a local command.
discovery_sources.cost: low-medium local recursive parse; no executing dynamic clauses.
discovery_sources.failure: Include, Match, token expansion, environment, unsupported directives.
cache expires; same-link only; asleep hosts absent.

discovery_sources.ssh_acceptance: No; announcement is not a listener or login.
discovery_sources.failure: multicast blocked, asleep/no advertisement, duplicate names.

discovery_sources.yields: Proxmox cluster node inventory/status via API.

discovery_sources.ssh_acceptance: No; endpoint may be local, remote, stale or unavailable.

discovery_sources.yields: Local kubeconfig context names; does not contact clusters.

discovery_sources.cost: local daemon IPC; may need group/root.
discovery_sources.failure: daemon absent, permission denied, URI confusion.

discovery_sources.source: Do not scan cloud CLI config or call cloud APIs by default.
discovery_sources.cost: external API may cause audit/network activity.

discovery_sources.source: Owner-approved bounded unauthenticated TCP connect/banner on port 22 or configured NetBird SSH route (NetBird documents an internal 22022 route in its standard setup).

discovery_sources.failure: Timeout conflates offline/firewall/policy/route; deployment-specific port mapping may differ.

probe_design.basis: D145 owner direction. contracts/bootstrap.md probe is enrollment preflight; this discovery probe is no-install one-shot mode.

preinstall_sniff.purpose: A shell-polyglot marker: cmd expands Windows percent variables and treats semicolons as echo text; PowerShell leaves percent tokens literal and expands env: variables; POSIX leaves percent tokens literal, then runs uname and reads os-release. Output is capped; no commands write or access the network.
preinstall_sniff.limit: Candidate only, not validated on Windows: no Windows host was available, so cmd and Windows PowerShell 5.1/7 were not empirically validated. Windows may emit bounded errors for uname/cat. Reject ambiguous/truncated output; parse Linux os-release as data and check special markers.

probe_design.execution: One SSH connection/round trip per target: sniff shell/OS/arch, then stream or invoke matching signed infraternal agent binary in --probe-once mode through SSH stdin/command path. It emits bounded JSON and exits without installing, enrolling, creating state or changing host configuration. Owner must decide how a matching binary is supplied transiently.
probe_design.collector: Rust infraternal agent collector uses native /proc,/sys,getifaddrs,sysctl,CIM and OS APIs first; bounded external commands are fallback only. Independent groups run with fixed worker cap, per-command timeout, output cap, process-group kill/reap and total deadline. No privilege escalation.

result_schema.privacy: No raw command output, secrets, keys, config blobs or unset values.

probe_design.refresh: Static: OS/kernel/arch/model/CPU/init/virtualization/package manager/agent mode at enrollment, upgrade or explicit refresh. Live: uptime/load/memory/disk/engine reachability only while Machine view is open; stop when closed. Sensitive/expensive facts are explicit opt-in and sampled on demand. Without an installed agent, the server has only the last snapshot unless a new user-approved SSH probe or enabled discovery integration runs.
probe_design.measurements: No target fact collector completed. The observed timings are only SSH/DNS/host-key failures, not collector performance.
